help.stone.title: {color, select, 1 {Blue} 2 {Yellow} 3 {Purple} 4 {Red} 5 {Green} other {}} Stone card of value {value}
help.stone.symbol: Symbol: {color, select, 1 {Ankh} 2 {Eye of Horus} 3 {Cup} 4 {Cat} 5 {Scarab} other {}}. The value is shown in the 4 corners (6 and 9 are underlined).
help.quarry: {count, plural, =0 {The quarry is empty} one {The quarry: # face down Stone card} other {The quarry: # face down Stone cards}}
help.quarry.draw: Drawing the top face down Stone card of the quarry costs 3 AP. You can keep a cursed card drawn from the quarry, but you cannot place it in your pyramid.
help.quarry.depleted: When there are no more Stone cards in the quarry, all the cards of the cursed discard piles except the top card of each pile are shuffled to form a new quarry.
help.stone.nile: On the Nile: collecting it costs {cost} AP. A player can never have more than 4 cards in hand.
help.stone.cursed.collect: This card is cursed: it cannot be collected from the Nile.
help.stone.place: Placing it in your pyramid costs 1 AP at level I, 2 AP at level II, 3 AP at level III. From level II onwards, it must be placed on 2 cards of the lower level, its supporting cards, and its value must be equal to either the sum or the difference of the values of its 2 supporting cards.
help.stone.cursed.place: This card is cursed: it cannot be placed in your pyramid.
help.stone.discard.hand: Discarding it from your hand costs 1 AP: drag it onto the cursed discard pile of your choice.
help.stone.hand.end: At the end of the game, the value of the Stone cards still in hand is subtracted from the Prestige points.
help.stone.pyramid.you: In your pyramid, level {level, select, 1 {I} 2 {II} other {III}}
help.stone.pyramid.top: Placing a Stone card at level III triggers the end of the game. At the end of the game, its value is added to the Prestige points. It cannot be discarded.
help.stone.discard.pyramid: Each Stone card of the pyramid earns 1 Prestige point. If it is not supporting any other card, it can be discarded: 2 AP at level I, 3 AP at level II.
help.stone.imhotep: In Imhotep’s pyramid, level {level, select, 1 {I} 2 {II} 3 {III} other {IV}}. Imhotep earns 1 point for each card placed, plus the value of the Stone card at level IV.
help.stone.curse.value: Cursed card: as long as it is visible, no Stone card with a value of {value} can be placed in a pyramid or collected from the Nile.
help.stone.curse.color: Cursed card: as long as it is visible, no {color, select, 1 {blue} 2 {yellow} 3 {purple} 4 {red} 5 {green} other {}} Stone card can be placed in a pyramid or collected from the Nile.
help.stone.curse.covered: This card is covered: only the top card of the discard pile is cursed.
help.nile.title: Nile card
help.nile.cost: Collecting the Stone card below this Nile card costs {cost} AP.
help.nile.quarry: The quarry is below this Nile card: drawing from it costs 3 AP.
help.nile.gaps: The empty spaces on the Nile are not filled before the end of the turn.
help.nile.fill: At the end of the turn, all the Stone cards in the Nile slip toward the cursed discard piles, then the empty spaces are filled by drawing from the quarry: the Nile once again contains 6 Stone cards.
help.objective.title: Common Objective card{type, select, 1 {, type 1} 2 {, type 2} 3 {, type 3} other {}}
objective.1: The sum of the cards from level II must equal 9
objective.2: Have more odd values than even values
objective.3: The sum of the cards from level I must equal 14
objective.4: The sum of the cards from level I must equal 13
objective.5: Have only cards of even value at level II
objective.6: Have only cards of odd value at level II
objective.7: Have as many cards of even value as cards of odd value
objective.8: Have only cards of odd value at level I
objective.9: Have only cards of even value at level I
objective.12: Have only one color at level I
objective.13: Have only one color at level II
objective.15: Have at least one green card at level I and level II
objective.16: Have at least one blue card at level I and one red card at level II
objective.18: Have at least 2 cards of identical value
help.objective.points: Each Common Objective card whose condition is met earns 3 Prestige points. They are achievable by all players.
help.objective.pyramid: Only the cards of the pyramid count. A level named by the condition must contain at least one card. 0 is an even value.
help.objective.solo: Solo mode: you must complete all the Common Objective cards; otherwise, you lose. Imhotep also scores the objectives he completes.
help.curse.value.title: Cursed discard card of the values
help.curse.color.title: Cursed discard card of the colors
help.curse.pile: {count, plural, =0 {Empty discard pile} one {# Stone card in this discard pile} other {# Stone cards in this discard pile}}
help.curse.value.rule: As long as a Stone card is visible in this discard pile, no Stone card of the same value can be placed in a pyramid or collected from the Nile.
help.curse.color.rule: As long as a Stone card is visible in this discard pile, no Stone card of the same color can be placed in a pyramid or collected from the Nile.
help.curse.top: A discarded Stone card is placed face up on top of the previous cards: it becomes the new cursed card of this discard pile.
help.curse.quarry: You can keep a cursed card in your hand when it is drawn face down from the quarry, but it cannot be placed in your pyramid.
help.curse.discard: It is always allowed to discard a cursed card. A card already placed that becomes cursed stays in the pyramid.
help.first-player.title: First player card
help.first-player.you: You are the first player. The first player does not change during the game.
help.first-player: {player} is the first player. The first player does not change during the game.
help.first-player.end: When a player places a Stone card at level III of their pyramid, they trigger the end of the game: each player takes one more turn until it returns to the first player (the first player does not take a final turn).
tuto.theme:
In 2680 BC, Pharaoh Djoser wants to erect the <bold>Step pyramid of Saqqara</bold>.
His architect Imhotep is looking for the greatest architect of Egypt: prove your worth!
tuto.goal: Your goal: build a <bold>pyramid of 6 Stone cards</bold> that earns the most <bold>Prestige points</bold>.
tuto.stones: These are the <bold>Stone cards</bold>: 5 colors, values from 0 to 9.
tuto.quarry: They come from the <bold>quarry</bold> along the <bold>Nile</bold>.
tuto.actions:
On your turn, you have <bold>3 AP</bold> (action points) to spend, at least 1.
Three possible actions: <bold>collect</bold>, <bold>place</bold> or <bold>discard</bold> a Stone card. You can perform the same action several times.
tuto.collect.cost:
Collecting a Stone card costs the number of blocks drawn on the boat above it: <bold>1, 2 or 3 AP</bold>.
Drawing the hidden card of the quarry costs <bold>3 AP</bold>.
tuto.collect.yellow3: Collect the <bold>yellow 3</bold> for 1 AP: click on it.
tuto.place.yellow3:
The card is in your hand. Beware: never <bold>more than 4 cards</bold> in hand.
Drag the yellow 3 onto a space of <bold>level I</bold> of your pyramid. Placing costs <bold>1 AP at level I</bold>, 2 AP at level II, 3 AP at level III.
tuto.green5: You have 1 AP left. Collect the <bold>green 5</bold>? Impossible: the boat above it costs 2 AP.
tuto.curses: These are the <bold>cursed discard piles</bold>. The top card of each one curses all the cards of the same <bold>color</bold> (left) or of the same <bold>value</bold> (right).
tuto.cursed:
A cursed card can <bold>neither be collected from the Nile nor be placed</bold> in a pyramid.
Here, purple and 4 are cursed: the <bold>purple 2</bold> and the <bold>red 4</bold> are shifted down.
tuto.end-turn: End your turn with the button at the top of the screen.
tuto.nile-fill:
You collected a card from the Nile: no discard at the end of the turn.
The cards of the Nile slip toward the discard piles, and the quarry fills the empty space.
tuto.laurent.draw: Laurent’s turn: he draws a card from the quarry, then ends his turn.
tuto.laurent.discard:
Laurent did not collect any card from the Nile: he must <bold>discard the 1st card of the Nile</bold> in the cursed discard pile of his choice.
He chooses the discard pile of values: the <bold>5</bold> becomes cursed!
tuto.collect.two: Your turn. Collect the <bold>green 2</bold> (1 AP), then the <bold>blue 1</bold> (2 AP).
tuto.end-turn.2: You have no AP left: you will place these cards next turn. End your turn.
tuto.place.two: Place the green 2 and the blue 1 at <bold>level I</bold>. Level I may keep a gap between 2 cards, to place a 3rd card there later.
tuto.level2:
From <bold>level II</bold> onwards, a card must be placed on <bold>2 cards of the lower level</bold>, its supporting cards.
Its value must be equal to the <bold>sum</bold> or the <bold>difference</bold> of the values of its 2 supporting cards.
tuto.level2.example:
For example, on a 3 and a 2, you can place a <bold>5</bold> (3 + 2) or a <bold>1</bold> (3 - 2).
When you drag a card, only the allowed spaces light up.
tuto.end-turn.3: You have 1 AP left, but no more cards in hand: end your turn.
tuto.end-discard:
You did not collect anything from the Nile this turn: discard the <bold>1st card of the Nile</bold>.
Choose the discard pile: changing the cursed value or color can hinder Laurent… or help you!
tuto.discard: Discarding a card costs <bold>1 AP from the hand</bold>, <bold>2 AP from level I</bold>, <bold>3 AP from level II</bold>, if it is not supporting any other card. The card of level III cannot be discarded.
tuto.objectives: These are the <bold>Common Objective</bold> cards. Each one completed by your pyramid earns <bold>3 Prestige points</bold>. All players can complete them.
tuto.end: Placing a card at <bold>level III</bold> triggers the end of the game: each player takes one more turn until it returns to the first player.
tuto.scoring:
At the end of the game, you score:
• <bold>1 point</bold> for each card placed in your pyramid
• the <bold>value</bold> of the card at level III
• <bold>3 points</bold> for each Common Objective card completed
• <bold>minus</bold> the value of the cards still in hand
In case of a tie, the pyramid with the highest sum of values wins.
tuto.go:
Now finish the game against Laurent!
<italic>At any time, click on a card to see its help.</italic>
